main_body: Tree-stump chopping block with a wide orange top ellipse and a darker bark front, plus a small grey axe head standing on top
top_band: Orange (#b77246, L~125) rows 4-7 at the middle column, rounded ellipse silhouette. The axe head (grey, rows 1-3) sits on it and is excluded.
evidence: Column x=11 steps from L=126 (top, rows 5-7) to L=68 (front, rows 8-13), a clear step of 58 L. At x=8 the step is smaller (124 to 101), but the silhouette is a wide rounded cap, wider than the shaft, with a 6-row bark face below. This matches the guide's barrel/stool ellipse top. The top is 4 rows with a rounded outline and the front is darker with a shadowed left edge. There is no separate 1-row front-edge line, but the tone step and the dark front under the top read as a correct 3/4 solid cylinder.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 10 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references, and a median of 10 per tile against 17-20. Wood has about 4-5 steps (b77246, 9a5435, 6d3b15, 63310b, 411e05), and the axe adds 3 greys. The bark face is mostly two flat-ish tones with a dark left edge column. The top ellipse has little grain or ring detail. About 53% of dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outline is partly tinted and partly neutral. It reads thinner and flatter than the stall and well references, although it has no 5x5 flat-fill blocks.
